items.description:

Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Hotel De Bordeaux provides quietness and comfort on the banks of the Canal du Midi. Toulouse Stadium is 5 km from the property.

Stay in one of the hotel's 31 soundproofed and air-conditioned rooms. A bar is also available for those wishing to relax and socialize after a long day spent sightseeing or working.

A continental breakfast is served on weekdays from 6:30 to 10:00 and until 11:30 on weekends

Hôtel de Bordeaux is located opposite Matabiau Train Station and 10 minutes' walk from the Capitole Theatre and the Saint Sernin Basilica. The hotel is a 15-minute drive from Blagnac Airport.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.2 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Plaza Hotel Capitole Toulouse
items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Plaza Hotel Capitole Toulouse. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

The 4* Plaza Hotel (formely Crowne Plaza) is ideally located in the heart of the city, 200meters from Capitole underground train network, 10km from Blagnac Airport and 15km from the Exhibition & Convention Center MEETT.
The Capitole Opera House is 200meters from the hotel & Pierre Baudis Convention Center is a 10-minutes walk.

In each of our 162 rooms & suites, a work desk area, TV Plasma screen, a bathroom with bathtub, safe box, Wifi, Tea/Coffe maker, telephones.
Some of our rooms offer a view over the Capitole Square.

The Continental buffet breakfast breakfast is served Monday to Friday from 06h30AM to 10h30AM and Saturday-Sunday till 11h00AM.
The restaurant-Bar “L’Atrium” is open daily for lunch and dinner. The Chef proposes delicious homemade dishes prepared with fresh and local products. The Atrium Bar welcomes you to enjoy a wide range of cocktails and drinks.

Our reception is open 24/7 all year round. And a free WIFI is available throughout the hotel.
The fitness center, reserved only for the hotel’s clients, is open daily from 06h30AM to 10h00PM.

Many tourist attractions are within walking distance from the hotel: Saint Sernin Cathedral, Couvent des Jacobins, Les Augustins Museum, Garonne river.

This is our guests' favorite part of Toulouse, according to independent reviews.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Courtyard by Marriott Toulouse Airport
items.description:
Courtyard By Marriott Toulouse Airport is just minutes from Toulouse Blagnac Airport and offers a seasonal outdoor heated swimming pool and free parking. It offers spacious and air-conditioned guest rooms. Toulouse Stadium is a 15-minute drive from the hotel.

A buffet breakfast consisting of a variety of hot and cold items is served every morning in the restaurant. Guests can also enjoy bistrot cuisine and great wine at lunch and dinner in the kitchen and Bar restaurant.

Courtyard By Marriott Toulouse Airport also has a 24-hour snack shop offering a large variety of snacks and homemade dishes, available 24/24 and a modern fitness centre. Wi-Fi access is also available at the hotel.

The central location of the Courtyard by Marriott Toulouse Airport offers you easy access by public transportation to such sights as Place du Capitole.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Novotel Toulouse Purpan Aéroport
items.description:
For your stays in Toulouse, head to Novotel Toulouse Purpan Airport. This hotel is perfect for all your visits: enjoy the modern spaces of the 123 rooms or a relaxing moment on the terrace by the pool. Ready for a gourmet break? Try the Chef's set menu at the Gourmet Bar. For a business meeting or seminar, the seven modular rooms are available. Come and enjoy the warm welcome of the southwest with us.

Novotel Toulouse Purpan Aéroport is between downtown Toulouse and Toulouse-Blagnac International Airport. Free shuttle service. Variety of sports facilities: volleyball, pétanque, tennis and table tennis! In Toulouse, experience the sky at Cité de l'espace, Aeroscopia or Airbus. Join in the ambiance of Stade Toulousain or watch a match at the stadium. Enjoy a concert at the Zénith, accessible by tram.

The Pink City of Toulouse, between the Garonne and the Canal du Midi. Festive Toulouse, vibrant Toulouse, gourmet Toulouse. Wander to Place du Capitole and be enchanted by the rhythm of the South West!
Welcome to Novotel Toulouse Purpan Aéroport !Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at La Cour des Consuls Hotel & Spa Toulouse - MGallery CollectionIn the heart of the pink city, La Cour Des Consuls Hotel And Spa Toulouse - MGallery Collection is situated In the center of old Toulouse in a 18th-century historic hotel, 1.4 km from Toulouse Expo and 3.5 km from Toulouse Stadium. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant, the Spa and a terrace with a bar and a brasserie.

The Cénacle our gastronomic restaurant is closed on saturday lunch, sunday and monday the whole day.

A flat-screen TV, as well as an iPod docking station are provided. Some rooms include a seating area to relax in after a busy day. You will find a kettle in the room. All rooms are equipped with a private bathroom. Extras include bath robes and slippers.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property and a parking valet from 7am to 11pm. A charging station for electric cars is available at this property.

Many of the main monuments like Saint Sernin or La Daubade churches are just 500, 800 metres from the hotel. The nearest airport is Blagnac Airport, 6 km from the property. Toulouse Matabiau Train Station is 2.3 km away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.2 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

Located south-west of Toulouse, B&B HOTEL Toulouse Université 3 étoiles offers a 24-hour reception and is just a 5-minute walk from University of Toulouse II. It features a restaurant with an outdoor terrace. Toulouse Stadium is 6 km away.

With free Wi-Fi access, the air-conditioned rooms are all non-smoking and they have a TV, radio and telephone. The private bathrooms are fitted with a bath and a shower.

A buffet breakfast composed of sweet and savoury dishes such as eggs, fruit salad, yogurts and juices is served every day. Pastries baked on site and fresh French Madeleine cakes are also on offer, as well as a hot beverage and a piece of fruit to take away. Outside of regular breakfast hours guests can also enjoy a lighter option, available from 04:00.

We offer a “snack” type catering service with pizzas and jars. You can find it directly at reception 7 days a week (while stocks last). Our bar service is open 24/7, alcohol sales end at 12 a.m. from Sunday to Thursday and 1 a.m. from Friday to Saturday.

With a free private car park on site, this hotel is 4.8 km from Golf Club La Ramée. The city centre, Toulouse Airport and Casino Barrière can all be reached within 10 minutes on the metro.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.0 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Citadines Wilson Toulouse
items.description:
Only a 5-minute walk from Place du Capitole and 5 km from Toulouse Stadium, the Citadines Apart'hotel is located in central Toulouse. It is an ideal base for discovering the magnificent architecture of the old Ville Rose district.

The Apart'hotel Toulouse Wilson offers 104 apartments and studios featuring a fully equipped kitchen with a microwave/grill, dishwasher and fridge, satellite TV and a work desk.

In the morning, a continental buffet breakfast is available. For lunch and dinner, you will find various restaurants nearby.

The nearby metro and bus lines mean getting around Toulouse is easy and Toulouse-Matabiau Train Station is only a few minutes on foot from the Citadines Apart'hotel.

The Saint-Sernin Basilica, the Jacobin Cloister and the City Hall are a 10-minute walk away. Also close by is the Fondation Bemberg, a collection of paintings housed in Toulouses stunning Hôtel d'Assézat.

The attentive staff at the Citadines Apart'hotel Toulouse Wilson will be happy to help you organise your stay 24-hours a day. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.4 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

All rooms at the Hotel Une Chambre en Ville are quiet, soundproofed, and air-conditioned. They also feature a flat-screen cable TV with smart TV capabilities and a private bathroom.

hostInfo.name: Appart'City
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Appart-Hôtel Appart’City Confort Toulouse Purpan Aéroport offers comfortable, 3-star self-contained accommodation with private parking and free Wi-Fi. The reception is open 24/7.
All 108 of our apartments are air-conditioned, fully furnished, and equipped with a flat-screen TV and a fully equipped kitchen featuring a microwave, refrigerator, cooking hobs, and dishware.
From studios to one-bedroom apartments accommodating up to 4 guests, they are perfectly suited for both business and leisure stays.
For added comfort, our team recommends our à la carte services, such as housekeeping or laundry facilities.
If you're looking to relax, you’ll enjoy free access to our wellness area, which includes a fully equipped fitness room with treadmill, elliptical trainer, rowing machine, weight bench, and exercise ball, as well as a sauna, highly appreciated by our guests.
Please note that the fitness room and sauna are available during specific hours details are available from our reception team.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: They say you can't have it all. Comfort or adventure ? Work or relaxation ? Freedom or hotel services ? What if we replaced “or” with “and” ? Welcome to Appart’City, France's leading aparthotel brand with over 90 destinations across France and Europe. We've reinvented hospitality to offer you a flexible, comfortable and perfectly suited option for all your stays, whether for business or leisure.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: The Appart’City Toulouse Purpan Aéroport aparthotel is also close to the Purpan shopping centre, the Zénith concert venue, aeronautical sites (with shuttle service) and multicultural activities, such as the city’s museums and the Cité de l’Espace space centre. Young and old will love exploring the “pink city” and discovering its lively atmosphere, cultural, architectural and gastronomic wealth and its “Rouge et Noir” sporting spirit. The 46 and 65 bus lines and line A of the metro ensure easy access to the city centre so that you can leave your car in our car park.

hostInfo.name: Société d'Exploitation Toulouse Purpan
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Welcome to Sevenline Aparthotel, a modern and welcoming residence located in Toulouse Purpan, where every detail is designed to make your business or leisure stays enjoyable. What makes our hotel unique is its exceptional location: upon arrival, you'll be whisked up to the 7th floor, where our reception and the SevenBistro restaurant offer breathtaking panoramic views of Toulouse and its surroundings.

Our 85 apartments are spacious and comfortable, fully equipped to meet your needs whether you're here for business or with family.

Our facilities are designed to make your stay as convenient as possible: fully equipped meeting rooms for your business needs, and a fitness area to stay in shape. Whether working or relaxing, you’ll always enjoy stunning views of the city.

At SevenBistro, we serve meals throughout the day. Our chef partners with local producers to create seasonal, authentic, and flavorful dishes, complemented by a carefully curated selection of wines from independent winemakers.

At Sevenline, every detail is crafted to provide a comfortable and pleasant experience in a contemporary yet warm setting. Whether you're staying for a night or a longer visit, our team is dedicated to making your stay truly memorable.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Sevenline, opened in October 2024, is the latest addition to the hotel branch of the Domitys group, the leading provider of senior residences in France. Building on this expertise, Domitys has developed a range of hotel accommodations that combine modern comfort with high-quality services. Sevenline joins three other properties in the group: Château Belmont Tours The Crest Collection, Citadines Eurométropole Strasbourg, and Citadines Apart'hotel Confluent Nantes.

Our residence features 85 apartments, including 70 studios and 15 one-bedroom units, ranging from 22 to 45 m². Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with a modern, elegant decor and equipped with a kitchenette, making it ideal for both short and long stays.

Our warm and dynamic team is here to welcome you and ensure that your stay is as pleasant as possible. Along with comfortable accommodations, you'll enjoy a friendly and inviting atmosphere, perfectly located in the vibrant Toulouse Purpan area.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
Located in the vibrant Purpan district, Sevenline Aparthotel offers an ideal location for both business travelers and tourists. Close to the Purpan Hospital and just steps away from the rapidly developing Cartoucherie eco-district, guests can enjoy the lively atmosphere of the Halles de la Cartoucherie, with its array of restaurants and shops, as well as La Cabane, a popular venue known for its diverse entertainment lineup.

In just ten minutes, you can reach Blagnac Airport, and within fifteen minutes, you’ll be in the heart of Toulouse at the iconic Place du Capitole. Whether you’re drawn to the bustling city center or looking for cultural and leisure activities, our prime location gives you easy access to Toulouse's main attractions.

PARKING: free public car park nearby (DIEULAFOY).
TRAM: Purpan stop (T1 line).
BUS: Chardonnet or Hôpital Purpan stops (45, 63 and L2 lines).

hostInfo.name: Appart'City
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Appart-Hôtel Appart’City Toulouse Saint Simon offers comfortable, 3-star self-contained accommodation with private parking and free Wi-Fi. Reception is available during the day, from Monday to Sunday.
Located in the quiet Saint Simon district, just 20 minutes from the city center and 10 minutes from Toulouse-Blagnac Airport, our property welcomes you in spacious Superior T3 or T4 villas—perfect for a warm and friendly stay.
Fully furnished and equipped, our apartments feature a functional kitchen and unlimited free Wi-Fi, offering all the comforts of home.
For a worry-free experience, enjoy our à la carte hotel services such as housekeeping or bed linen changes.
For leisure, take advantage of our games area with ping-pong tables and a pétanque court, our fitness room, and our seasonal outdoor swimming pool.
These facilities are accessible during specific hours—please check with our reception team for details.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: They say you can't have it all. Comfort or adventure ? Work or relaxation ? Freedom or hotel services ? What if we replaced “or” with “and” ? Welcome to Appart’City, France's leading aparthotel brand with over 90 destinations across France and Europe. We've reinvented hospitality to offer you a flexible, comfortable and perfectly suited option for all your stays, whether for business or leisure.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: Three buses pass by the residence and the nearest metro stop is 5 minutes away by car (or 10 by bus). You can leave your car at the metro park and ride and get to Place du Capitole in just 10 minutes. There, you will find a city centre full of museums, monuments and shops. We have all the leaflets you could wish for so that you are as well informed as possible on your stay in the south west.
